items.title: 'The world must see': Zelenskyy shares video of drone hunting vegetable seller

children.content: Ukraine accuses Russia of committing a war crime after video is released showing a drone chasing down and wounding a vegetable seller in the southern city of Kherson.

The man, identified only as Yurii, survived but suffered shock and shrapnel injuries, according to Ukrainian officials.
